name: g2_giants_isi
label: ISI at Palomar with ID230s: red giants, supergiants and red-clump stars, 900 and 1550 nm, a baseline per night from 3 m to 1 km
notes: Each schedule entry is one night per backend on the ISI pair at that baseline (East-West): the trucks move between nights. The runner reports every configuration and the combined Fisher precision on the diameter and on the linear limb-darkening coefficient.

The ID230's 2 us dead time caps every giant brighter than H ~ 1 at the same 2.5e5 cps, so all of them give S/N ~ 6 per 1550 nm night at |V|^2 = 1 (2 at 900 nm); the programme is detector-limited and the gain is in geometry: the null position, the sidelobe level (limb darkening) and the 900 vs 1550 nm size difference. hd360 (H 2.6) is the one target below the cap.
First nulls at 1550 / 900 nm: Betelgeuse 9.3 / 5.4 m, Aldebaran 18.9 / 11.0, Arcturus 18.6 / 10.8, mu Cep 27.9 / 16.2, eps Tau 145 / 84, HD 360 431 / 250 m.
